message:
test(keepalive-r2 A r3): the real directory server's relay -- two standby leases through server.js, a real host

Codex decision 1 (a): "a limited local test of the real server.js with several leases". --real-directory runs
apps/directory/server.js under node (loopback ports, its data and logs in its own staging directory, a job object),
a real GNLinkStream registered and heartbeating to it, and two raw clients that sign in, observe and ask
/api/connect {standby:true}. The host collects both capabilities and punches both reserved host-facing ports
(the extra pendingPunch entries); both leases pin it; B and C are admitted through the relay as their own entries
(bound + ready on two sockets), no session; B activates over its lease (HelloAck back, lease active) and its
control works; C keeps pinging, its window-selects and resumes are never processed and B keeps its epoch; C's
explicit activation takes it; B's late control is refused and B, parked, still pings.

e2e --old-host <baseline> --real-directory: 89/89. Loopback crosses no NAT: the NAT path is shown only up to "the
host punched the reserved port and the lease pinned it".

Product / test / docs: product (none) / test (standby admission e2e) / docs (none).
